issues.display_title: Issue #1274: Map: snap panorama links to roads (straight lines along the road instead of GPS waves)
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From client feedback ("is it possible to snap the Blue Line to the vector path, if existent? … that's what Google does, and the lines look perfectly straight, no waves"), with a screenshot of https://map-thru.com/v/Hmszds8m (project fbe8464f, Pelee Island) at East West Road × Centre Dyke Road.

Today

A panorama project's links (canvasData.panoLinks) are drawn pin to pin, at each panorama's own position. On Hmszds8m the 4,696 panoramas sit a median 8.1 m from the road's centre line (69% within 15 m), so the line and its dots wave beside the road instead of following it.

A prototype on that project's data (read only, from the public page) matched 84% of the panoramas onto roads in our own OpenMapTiles tiles (map-embed-orig.gothru.co, transportation layer at z14), and the line ran straight down the middle of each road.

Scope

Revised after the user tried the first version (#1275). That version was a project setting that matched every link at once and only changed the drawing. The user wanted to snap by hand, and to move the pins themselves.

  1. Snap to roads (magnet) is a toggle on the editor's Map toolbar, not a project setting. It loads the roads around the floor's panoramas when switched on.
  2. With it on, a panorama dragged near a road (within 25 m) sticks to it and is dropped there.
  3. Shift-click or Shift-drag selects several panoramas. Moving them matches the run onto its road (HMM), so it doesn't zig-zag between nearby roads.
  4. Auto snap (wand) snaps the selection, or every panorama on the floor, in one click.
  5. The pins themselves move. Every drag and every Auto snap is one undo step. A panorama with no road within 25 m stays where it is dropped.
  6. Dependencies: @mapbox/vector-tile and pbf become direct dependencies (approved by the user).

Acceptance criteria

  • With Snap to roads on, a panorama dragged off its road at East West Road × Centre Dyke Road lands on the road; with it off, it lands under the pointer.
  • A Shift-selected group moved off its road lands on it.
  • Auto snap puts the selection, or the whole floor, on the roads, and one Ctrl+Z undoes it.
  • Panoramas far from any road keep their position.
  • The snapped positions are saved (they survive an editor reload).
  • Unit tests for the matcher, the snapping, the toggle and Auto snap.

RESULT

video-1274-snap-to-roads.mp4

Released to main in 3e687bf5 (release PR #1279), Deploy succeeded.

How it got there

  • #1275 first shipped a project setting in Edit Project Info. It matched every linked pin once and drew the matches over the pins. After trying it on :6060, the user asked for snapping while dragging instead.
  • #1276 replaced it with the Snap to roads toggle, single and Shift-selected group drags, and moving the pins themselves.
  • #1277 added Auto snap.
  • #1275's setting, its canvasData.snapPanoLinks and panoSnap keys, and its display override were removed before release.

How it works

  • Roads: from our own OpenMapTiles server (map-embed-orig.gothru.co, transportation at z14). Ferry, rail and transit are skipped. They are loaded around the active floor's panoramas when the toggle is switched on; a failed load switches it off and says so.
  • Matcher (roadMatch.ts, createRoadMatcher): an HMM with Viterbi and Dijkstra over the road graph, 25 m reach. A run follows its road and only changes road at a junction.
  • Snapping (roadSnap.ts):
    • snapPoint places a single drag;
    • snapGroup matches the links inside a selection as polylines;
    • snapPanoramasToRoads is Auto snap.
  • Live vs release: up to 400 panoramas follow live during a group drag; a bigger selection snaps on release. Rotate and scale are not snapped. Re-snapping a pin already on its road is no edit.
  • State: useRoadSnapStore holds the toggle and the matcher. The toggle ends with the Map tab.

Tests: roadMatch (6), roadTiles (5), roadSnap (11), plus MapObjectMarkers (+2), usePanoramaGroupGesture (+3) and EditorBottomToolbar.snapRoads (6). The mutants were all caught. pnpm test (3138), pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit and next build pass.

Checked on production (map-thru.com), on scratch copies of Pelee Island (101be377), deleted afterwards. Distances are pin to road, on screen, at z19:

  • check-drag-snap.mjs 4/4:
    • toggle off, a drag lands 82 px off the road;
    • toggle on, the same drag lands at 0 px;
    • a Shift-selected group of 4 lands at 0 px;
    • after the auto-save and an editor reload, they are still at 0 px.
  • check-auto-snap.mjs 4/4:
    • Auto snap is disabled until the roads are in;
    • 18 panoramas went from 26–46 px to 0 px;
    • one Ctrl+Z put all 18 back;
    • with 4 selected, only those 4 moved.

Demo: .playwright-mcp/demo/1274/video-1274-snap-to-roads.mp4 (1:19, on acefbb6f, Pelee Island Blue Line (Demo) - copy; its Auto snap result was saved there).

Commits: 4e88d618 (#1275), fde7daf0 (#1276), eba4f267 (#1277).

issues.display_title: Issue #1280: Auth: show the GoThru logo on the Continue with GoThru button
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

From #1278. The Continue with GoThru button on the login and register pages shows a key icon; it should show the GoThru logo.

Today

src/components/auth/ProviderSignInButton.tsx draws GoThru's icon with lucide's KeyRound. That was a placeholder until product picked the GoThru mark (#1080, open question 2), and the code says so.

Scope

  1. The GoThru button shows the GoThru logo (public/img/logo192.png, the round red, orange and blue mark) at 16 px, the same size as the Google logo on the button above it.
  2. Both forms (login and register) share the button, so both change.

Acceptance criteria

  • Continue with GoThru shows the GoThru logo instead of the key, on the login and register pages.
  • The logo is the same size as the Google logo and doesn't change the button's height.
  • Unit test.

RESULT

video-1280-gothru-logo.mp4

Released to main in 5055d45d (PR #1281 → development 13dec274, release PR #1282). Deploy succeeded.

What changed

  • src/components/auth/ProviderSignInButton.tsx: GothruMark now draws public/img/logo192.png (the GoThru mark provided with #1278) at 16 px, the size of the Google logo above it, instead of lucide's KeyRound placeholder from #1080.
  • The login and register forms share the button, so both changed.
  • The logo file is added under public/img/.

Tests: ProviderSignInButton.logo.test.tsx (2):

  • the GoThru button shows the logo, has no key icon, and the file exists;
  • the Google button keeps its own SVG.

Both fail on the old code. pnpm test (3140), pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit and next build pass.

Checked on production (map-thru.com, logged out; .playwright-mcp/demo/1280/check-logo.mjs, 2/2):

  • On /login and /register, the GoThru logo is loaded (192 px natural), drawn 16×16 like the Google logo, and both buttons are 44 px tall.
  • https://map-thru.com/img/logo192.png serves 200 image/png, 21 KB.

Demo video (A/B): .playwright-mcp/demo/1280/video-1280-gothru-logo.mp4. Screenshot: .playwright-mcp/demo/1280/compare-login.png.
